analyzed_vuln.description: The vulnerability is a stack-buffer-overflow caused by reading beyond the allocated size of the key array in the zbee_sec_add_key_to_keyring function. Specifically, the function uses memcmp to compare a key of size ZBEE_APS_CMD_KEY_LENGTH (16 bytes) without ensuring that the provided key argument is also of the same size, leading to a potential overflow if an invalid key is passed.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: This vulnerability can be triggered when dissecting ZBEE APS transport commands that include a key longer than expected. If the provided key in the dissect_zbee_aps_transport_key function exceeds the defined ZBEE_APS_CMD_KEY_LENGTH, it can lead to a stack buffer overflow in zbee_sec_add_key_to_keyring.
